description: Conversion of garage to habitable room; Replace garage door with window in front elevation; First floor side extension; Single and two storey rear extension; Creation of basement level; External alterations (Demolition of Conservatory)
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height:normal">Location Plan; Construction Method Statement and Stability Design; Flood Risk Assessment; Reasonable Exception Statement; Planning Statement; PR23-070a; PR23-070b; PR23-070c; PR23-070d; PR23-070f; PR23-070c (Existing &amp; Proposed Sections); PR23-070c (Rooflight Detail); PR23-070g.</span>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The window(s) in the side elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height:normal">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development shall not commence until details for basement protection for ground water flooding, which would include waterproofing and water tanking details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height:normal">Reason: To build in resistance and resilience in managing, reducing and mitigating the effects of flood risk following guidance in the National Planning Policy Framework. To ensure that the proposed works can be incorporated in to the design, this is PRE-COMMENCEMENT Condition.</span></p>
